text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Grown-up cosmetics for my birthday 
present!? If Maya uses this, will she 
become a mature woman too?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she could~. Laurel-san picked out 
something with great taste~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Nature-chan picked out something really 
practical for everyday use, so you can 
start using it right away today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay! With this, I'm one step closer to 
being a grown-upâª

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan, what do you want to be when you 
grow up?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see! Well, you see! There are 
tons, but first off—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna help you, Trainer! Grown-up work! 
And then, you'll give me tons of praise!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
S-So bright... My impure soul is being 
totally cleansed...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, hope we can do that someday.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thank you! Maya's gonna grow up 
into a wonderful, cool big sister just 
like you two!
